hero.title: Heaven on Earth Kingdom Family Ministries
hero.subtitle: Your kingdom come, your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.

welcome.title: Welcome to Our Church
welcome.subtitle: A Place of Faith, Love, and Community
welcome.description: We are a family of believers dedicated to spreading the Gospel of Jesus Christ, nurturing spiritual growth, and serving our community in Addis Ababa and beyond. Join us as we seek to bring heaven to earth through prayer, worship, and love.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To make disciples of all nations, teaching them to observe all that Christ has commanded, and bringing the Kingdom of God to every home and community.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: To see families transformed by the power of the Gospel, communities renewed by the love of Christ, and nations reached with the message of salvation.

prayer.title: Prayer Ministry
prayer.description: 24/7 prayer coverage, prayer vigils, and intercession for families and nations.

outreach.title: Community Outreach
outreach.description: Food distribution, helping the needy, and showing Christ's love through action.

discipleship.title: Discipleship
discipleship.description: Bible studies, small groups, and spiritual mentoring for growth in faith.

youth.title: Youth Ministry
youth.description: Weekly meetings, mentorship, and activities for young believers.

children.title: Children's Ministry
children.description: Sunday School, Bible stories, and nurturing the faith of our little ones.

worship.title: Worship Ministry
worship.description: Leading the congregation in Spirit-filled worship through music and arts.

women.title: Women's Ministry
women.description: Empowering women to grow in faith and support one another in community.

missions.title: Missions
missions.description: Spreading the Gospel to unreached communities in Ethiopia and beyond.

getInvolved.description: God has given each of us unique gifts and talents. We'd love to help you discover your calling and find a place to serve in our church family.

hero.title: About Our Ministry
hero.description: Discover our story, beliefs, and the team behind Heaven on Earth Kingdom Family Ministries

story.title: Our Story
story.description: Heaven on Earth Kingdom Family Ministries was founded in 2005 with a vision to create a place where people can experience the love and power of God in their lives.

beliefs.title: Our Core Beliefs
beliefs.subtitle: What we stand for and believe in

bible.title: The Bible
bible.description: We believe the Bible is the inspired, infallible Word of God, the supreme authority for faith and life.

trinity.title: The Trinity
trinity.description: We believe in one God, eternally existing in three persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.

salvation.title: Salvation
salvation.description: We believe salvation is by grace through faith in Jesus Christ alone, not by works.

church.title: The Church
church.description: We believe in the universal church as the body of Christ, called to worship, fellowship, and mission.

returnOfChrist.title: The Return of Christ
returnOfChrist.description: We believe in the personal, visible return of Jesus Christ to establish His Kingdom.

pastorAbraham.name: Pastor Abraham
pastorAbraham.description: Leading our congregation with vision and compassion for over 15 years.

sisterTigist.name: Sister Tigist
sisterTigist.description: Dedicated to empowering women through faith and fellowship.

brotherDaniel.name: Brother Daniel
brotherDaniel.description: Passionate about raising the next generation of believers.

sundayWorship.title: Sunday Worship Service
sundayWorship.description: Join us for powerful worship, prayer, and the Word of God.

wednesdayPrayer.title: Wednesday Prayer Meeting
wednesdayPrayer.description: Corporate prayer and intercession for our community and nation.

fridayYouth.title: Youth Fellowship
fridayYouth.description: Bible study, worship, and fellowship for young believers.

prayer.title: Prayer Requests
prayer.subtitle: Casting all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you.
prayer.otherWays: Other Ways to Submit Prayer Requests

commitment.title: Our Prayer Commitment
commitment.body: Every prayer request submitted is prayed over by our dedicated prayer team. We believe in the power of intercessory prayer and are committed to standing with you in faith. Your requests are kept confidential and handled with love and care.

wall.title: Prayer Wall
wall.join: Join us in praying for our community

prayer.homePageDescription: We believe in the power of prayer. Share your prayer requests with us, and our prayer team will intercede for you.

partnership.title: Partner With Us
partnership.subtitle: Join us in bringing the Kingdom of God to every home and community.
partnership.description: At Heaven on Earth Kingdom Family Ministries, we believe that together, we can make a greater impact for God's Kingdom. Whether through financial support, volunteering, or material contributions, your partnership helps us reach more souls, serve more families, and transform more communities.
partnership.formIntro: Fill out the form to express your interest in partnering with us. Our team will reach out to discuss how we can work together for Kingdom impact.
reasons: Be part of a community transforming lives through the Gospel
Support sustainable ministry initiatives in Ethiopia
Invest in the spiritual development of families
Contribute to community outreach and humanitarian efforts
Join a network of believers committed to God's Kingdom

financial.title: Financial Partnership
financial.description: Support our ministry through regular or one-time financial contributions.

volunteer.title: Volunteer Partnership
volunteer.description: Serve in various capacities using your time, skills, and talents.

material.title: Material Partnership
material.description: Provide resources and supplies for our community outreach programs.

gallery.subtitle: Capturing moments of faith, worship, and community

giving.title: Give Generously
giving.subtitle: Honor the Lord with your wealth, with the firstfruits of all your crops.
giving.description: Giving is an act of worship and obedience to God. When we give, we acknowledge that everything we have belongs to Him, and we partner with His work in transforming lives and communities. Your generosity enables us to continue spreading the Gospel, serving the needy, and building the Kingdom of God.

options.title: Tithe
options.description: Honor God with the first 10% of your income.
options.verse: 'Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse...' - Malachi 3:10

options.title: Offering
options.description: Give generously beyond your tithe as God leads.
options.verse: 'Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart...' - 2 Corinthians 9:7

options.title: Missions
options.description: Support the spread of the Gospel to unreached areas.
options.verse: 'Go and make disciples of all nations...' - Matthew 28:19

options.title: Building Fund
options.description: Contribute to expanding our church facilities.
options.verse: 'Unless the Lord builds the house, the builders labor in vain...' - Psalm 127:1
